description: No key needed for a token from a preview made without a key, once the person has claimed it (the first download costs 1 credit from their account); before that it answers status "waiting_for_claim" with the claim_url. Other tokens need an API key. Gets a file for an image token from an earlier conversion, with a fresh signed download link valid for 1 hour. Free for any format of a token you already paid for. The first download of a preview token, or of a token from a queued conversion, costs 1 credit. The file is included inline up to inline_max_bytes, as for convert_image_to_svg. If that trace is still queued or running, it answers with an error giving its place and how many seconds to wait; nothing is charged, so call it again then.

inline_max_bytes.description: Largest file, in bytes, to include in the result itself (default 16384; 1048576 for PNG). Larger files come only as the download link. 0 never inlines.

name: download_vector

download_url.description: Signed link to the file, no key needed.

inline.description: Whether the file is in the result content.

svg.description: The SVG markup, when the format is svg and the file is inlined.
